scope: Online retail and discount candidates only; visualization research, no BOM selection or purchase authorization.

baseline.name: Jennifer Taylor Home Alpine
baseline.shape_note: Gently rounded profile, not a true half-moon.

recommendation.reason: Strongest black retail match to the approved crescent. Official angled photography visibly proves a concave conversation arc, and the live Walmart offer is only $84.79 above the sofa baseline.
recommendation.tradeoff: The 100.5 by 47.5 inch footprint adds 10 inches of width and 11.5 inches of depth; exact occupied-layout and delivery-route checks are required.

candidates.color: Black performance velvet with gold stainless steel base
candidates.shape_assessment: True concave crescent; confirmed by official three-quarter product photography.
candidates.price_status: Black variant showed Add to cart, free shipping, sold and shipped by Modway. Manufacturer direct was preorder-only at $1,674.40.
candidates.construction: Dense foam, individually wrapped pocket coils, removable seat cushion and cover; fully assembled; stated maximum capacity 900 lb.
candidates.fit_gate: Re-run M-12 at 100.5 by 47.5 inches and M-15 for a fully assembled sofa.

candidates.shape_assessment: Deep sculptural conversation arc; confirmed by official and retailer three-quarter imagery.
candidates.price_status: High Fashion Home showed In Stock and 4–6 weeks for the special order. Furniture.com showed the same price, free shipping, sold by TOV, ships within 4 weeks.
candidates.construction: Kiln-dried pine frame, spring support, fiber-wrapped foam; fully assembled.
candidates.fit_gate: Re-run M-12 at 89.7 by 43.7 inches and M-15. Published carton is approximately 90.8 by 44.5 by 30.7 inches.

candidates.color: Black velvet with brushed-gold stainless base
candidates.shape_assessment: Visible curved shell and concave seat front; shallower and more modern than the approved traditional crescent.
candidates.price_status: Black velvet showed 1 left and free full-service delivery. The displayed delivery window was ZIP-specific.
candidates.construction: Black velvet, pocket-spring seat, brushed-gold stainless base; fully assembled; published minimum door width 24 inches.
candidates.fit_gate: Re-run M-12 at 91.5 by 40 inches; Wayfair publishes a 24-inch minimum door width, but the room route still requires M-15.

rejected.reason: Marketing says half-moon, but usable product imagery reads nearly straight or only softly bowed.
Low-cost foam floor sofa with a bubble front; does not deliver the requested conversation crescent.
Dark glam finish but visibly shallow curve.
Live structured data showed out of stock.
Black variants were out of stock during direct checks.

limitations: Stock, prices, and delivery estimates are volatile and must be rechecked for the project ZIP immediately before purchase.
No candidate is approved for purchase or selected into the BOM by this research.
Published dimensions do not prove occupied-room clearance or the delivery route.
